settings.question: What is [brand]?
settings.answer: A daily gummy formulated to support mood, desire, and feeling connected — designed as one small, consistent ritual rather than an on-demand product.

settings.question: How do I take it?
settings.answer: One gummy, once a day, with or without food. The final label directions are the source of truth.

settings.question: When should I take it?
settings.answer: Any time you can stay consistent with — morning coffee, evening wind-down, whatever you’ll actually keep.

settings.question: How long should I use it?
settings.answer: Give it several consistent weeks, then check in with yourself. Daily support tends to feel gradual, and experiences vary.

settings.question: What's inside?
settings.answer: KSM-66 Ashwagandha, Black Maca, Damiana, and Cinnamon Bark. The full ingredient list always appears on the label — no hidden blends.

settings.question: Can I take it with medication?
settings.answer: Talk with a qualified healthcare professional before use if you take any medication, are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have a medical condition.

settings.question: How does the subscription work?
settings.answer: Choose a delivery schedule at checkout and your order arrives automatically, with any subscription savings applied to each delivery. You stay in control and can manage or cancel at any time.

settings.question: What is the return policy?
settings.answer: Returns and refunds are handled under our refund policy — you’ll find the full details linked in the footer, and our support team is happy to help.

settings.title: I finally feel like me again.
settings.text: I started adding Smooch to my daily routine mostly because I wanted something simple I could actually stay consistent with. The biggest thing I've noticed is that I just feel more like myself lately — more present, more in the mood, and less like I'm running on empty all the time.
settings.author: Maya T.

settings.title: My favorite part of my evening routine.
settings.text: I keep the bottle right on my nightstand so I don't forget.
settings.author: Alyssa R.

settings.title: I didn't realize how disconnected I'd been feeling.
settings.text: Between work, stress, and everything else, intimacy had slowly moved to the bottom of my list. I wanted something that felt easy instead of adding another complicated wellness routine. Smooch has become one of those little daily things I genuinely look forward to.
settings.author: Rachel M.

settings.title: Self-care, but make it easy.
settings.text: Two gummies and I'm done. No powders, no complicated routine.
settings.author: Chloe D.

settings.title: Didn't expect to care about the mood side this much.
settings.text: I originally found Smooch because of the libido angle, but what made it stick for me was the whole mood-and-connection positioning. It feels less like taking a 'sex supplement' and more like something that belongs in my regular wellness routine.
settings.author: Jenna P.

settings.title: Finally, women's wellness that doesn't feel clinical.
settings.text: The branding got me. The routine kept me.
settings.author: Sofia L.

settings.title: The consistency is what surprised me.
settings.text: I've bought plenty of supplements that ended up forgotten in a cabinet. These are easy enough that they've actually become part of my routine, which was the whole battle for me.
settings.author: Lauren K.

settings.title: Way easier than another capsule.
settings.text: I already take enough pills. Gummies were an immediate yes.
settings.author: Natalie S.

settings.title: She's staying on the nightstand.
settings.text: Pretty packaging, easy habit, and something that's actually for us.
settings.author: Camille B.

settings.title: I wanted my spark back.
settings.text: I don't think there was one dramatic moment. It was more that I started noticing I felt more intentional about that part of myself again. That's exactly what I wanted from adding something like this to my routine.
settings.author: Erin C.

settings.title: These actually taste like a treat.
settings.text: Which makes remembering them very easy.
settings.author: Katie N.

settings.text: I have a career, a relationship, a million things on my brain, and usually wellness products feel like one more task. Smooch doesn't. That's probably my favorite thing about it.
